messages:
sam (support): heads-up — customer acct cus_9123 reporting recurring 504/5xx from hosted inference this morning during a burst at ~2026-03-15T11:23Z :rotating_light:

sam (support): summary from them: spikes of parallel requests -> ~15s queue time -> a bunch of 504s. Happens on /v1/generate against model=gptx-4o-16k-q4. They saw errors starting 2026-03-15T11:22:30 UTC and lasting ~15m.

sam (support): logs customer sent: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T11:23:09Z gateway: upstream timeout after 15s; status=504; request_id=rq_abc123
TRACE request_id=rq_abc123 path=/v1/generate model=gptx-4o-16k-q4 queue_ms=15200
```

sam (support): customer SLA impact, they open a support ticket asking for timeline and mitigation. Putting oncall in thread.

maria (oncall-sre): looking now. can you paste the endpoint + region and any deployment id? also did they attach the request payload size/sequence length?

sam (support): endpoint: eu-west-1 /hosted/rt/generate, deployment name: deploy-gptx-4o-16k-q4-prod (customer-shared). avg seq len ~6k tokens in these requests (they said long prompts).

tess (eng-sre): grabbing autoscaler events and kube state. initial glance: ScaledObject shows minReplicaCount=0, cooldownPeriod=300, pollingInterval=30. HPA target 60% cpu. That could explain slow scale-up under a sudden spike.

tess (eng-sre): also seeing readinessProbe is fairly strict: initialDelaySeconds=5, periodSeconds=10, failureThreshold=3. But the container reports Ready only after model init which is ~18s — pod doesn't register as ready quickly so HPA/KEDA <> kube controller timing leads to delayed add of endpoints to service.

maria (oncall-sre): events snippet: 
```
Events:
  Type    Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----    ------     ----  ----               -------
  Normal  SuccessfulCreate  10m  deployment-controller  Created pod deploy-gptx-4o-16k-q4-prod-5f7d
  Warning BackOff    9m   kubelet             Back-off restarting failed container
  Normal  ScalingReplicaSet 8m  horizontal-pod-autoscaler Scaled up to 1 from 0
```

maria (oncall-sre): note: scaled to 1 only after ~60s of sustained metric — but model init + image pull + GKIM step adds another ~20s. Combined means ~80-100s coldstart before traffic can be served -> timeouts at 15s.

lee (eng-runtime): confirming model init numbers from profiling: coldstart (container start -> ready) median=22s, p90=35s for this model on the prod instance type (a10g-16). Major time is memory mapping and KV cache build. We currently have PREWARM=false for this deployment.

lee (eng-runtime): we also disabled async-kv-preload as part of last optimization because it increased memory pressure for some tenants. That change reduced steady cost but increased coldstart times for large models.

sam (support): customer asked for repro steps. can we produce a quick repro on staging before sending them a mitigation?

tess (eng-sre): repro recipe: run 30 concurrent short requests to that endpoint from an external load generator with low timeout (10s) to emulate their burst. e.g., use hey or vegeta. example: 
```
# quick smoke repro (from bastion in eu-west-1)
hey -n 200 -c 30 -z 1m -t 10s "https://eu-west-1.redwood/api/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -m POST -d '{"model":"gptx-4o-16k-q4","input":"<~6k tokens>"}'
```

tess (eng-sre): kubectl snippets to inspect scaler: 
```
kubectl get scaledobject deploy-gptx-4o-16k-q4-prod -n hosted -o yaml
kubectl get hpa deploy-gptx-4o-16k-q4-prod -n hosted -o yaml
kubectl describe deployment deploy-gptx-4o-16k-q4-prod -n hosted
```

maria (oncall-sre): short-term mitigation options (fast):
- patch ScaledObject/HPA to set minReplicaCount=2 for this deployment (pre-allocate)
- reduce KEDA pollingInterval to 5s and cooldownPeriod to 60s for the class of latency-sensitive models
- increase gateway timeout to 90s for this customer path while we work on long-term fix (needs approval)

tess (eng-sre): I can roll the minReplicaCount change. propose: set minReplicaCount=2 and add annotation autoscaler.keda.sh/polling-interval=5. that should eliminate coldstart in most bursts. I'll coordinate a quick patch.

lee (eng-runtime): long-term: re-enable async kv preload for large model class with guard (ENV PREWARM=1 per deployment) and provide a lightweight warmup endpoint that will materialize weights and KV cache before traffic. Also consider keeping a tiny warm worker pool (minReplicas=1) for throughput-critical customers.

sam (support): customer-facing message draft — please review: 
```
Hi — we investigated and root cause is autoscaler + coldstart overlap. We will provision pre-warmed replicas and tweak autoscaler to prevent timeouts. ETA for mitigation: ~15-20m. We'll follow up with postmortem and permanent fixes.
```
deploy-bot: deploy event: deploy/gptx-4o-16k-q4-prod rolled at 2026-03-15T11:15Z by lee (eng-runtime) — image v2.34.3. rollback happened at 11:18Z to v2.34.2.

maria (oncall-sre): that rollback may have reset warm caches — good catch. rollback right before the spike could have increased coldstart probability.

tess (eng-sre): performing the patch now: `kubectl patch scaledobject deploy-gptx-4o-16k-q4-prod -n hosted --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicaCount","value":2}]'` and adding annotation. will post status.

tess (eng-sre): PATCH applied. minReplicaCount=2. KEDA annotation polling-interval applied. Monitor metrics for next 20m.

maria (oncall-sre): created incident card and assigned owner lee. Actions:
1) short-term: keep minReplicaCount=2 for 24h and notify customers (tess)
2) medium: add PREWARM flag + warmup endpoint and test (lee)
3) long-term: review autoscaler defaults for latency-sensitive tiers (eng-sre + product)

lee (eng-runtime): I'll implement PREWARM toggle and a warmup handler on staging. will run a canary with minReplicaCount=1 -> PREWARM=1 to validate memory impact. target: changes in next 3 sprint days.

sam (support): sent the customer the mitigation note. they acknowledged and asked for ETA — provided 20m for mitigation and weekly follow-up for permanent fix.

maria (oncall-sre): monitoring — p50/p95 request latency and 5xx count trending down after minReplica patch. keep watching and post final update when stable.

sam (support): thanks all. I'll update support ticket when we get stable period.

maria (oncall-sre): post-incident: owner lee to file postmortem with the following sections: timeline, root cause (rollback + autoscaler defaults + readiness probe mismatch + disabled prewarm), mitigations applied, long-term plan, follow-up items. deadline: EOD+2.

lee (eng-runtime): ack. I'll add repro in staging (hey script + kube patch steps) to the runbook and link in the postmortem.

sam (support): closing loop with customer once we hit 30m stable window.

maria (oncall-sre): closing note — consider global policy: for models with coldstart>10s and expected bursty traffic, default minReplicaCount=1 and PREWARM opt-in. we'll discuss in next infra sync. :white_check_mark:
